title: Mystic Portal and Golden Mask
description: A surreal dark fantasy scene featuring an ornate golden tribal mask with spiral patterns on the left, and a glowing, elongated portal-like object with a prominent interlocking 'GG' logo at its center. The portal emits iridescent light and is surrounded by dense, dark foliage, golden ferns, and dramatic god rays piercing through a misty jungle atmosphere.
